adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, `comments` is assigned via `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` and then used unconditionally in `comments.appendChild(iframe);`. If the element is absent, `comments` will be `null` and this will throw a `TypeError` at runtime. The diff contains no guard/bail-out for this case.
